items.titleZh: VCARB可能不会让劳森参加Q3以确保他不超越林德布拉德
items.summaryZh: VCARB可能不会让劳森参加Q3以避免他超越林德布拉德，林德布拉德因此减少一个发车位，劳森无论如何都将升至第9位
items.originalTitle: Think VCARB might not run Lawson in Q3 to ensure he doesn’t out qualify Lindblad. Lindblad then loses one fewer spot with his five-place grid penalty...
items.summaryEn: Think VCARB might not run Lawson in Q3 to ensure he doesn’t out qualify Lindblad. Lindblad then loses one fewer spot with his five-place grid penalty, and Lawson moves up to P9 regardless #F1 #USGP
detailZh: Think VCARB可能不会让劳森在Q3（第三节练习与排位）参赛，以确保他不超越林德布拉德（Lindblad）的资格。林德布拉德由于五位的网格处罚（grid penalty），他的位置减少一个，而劳森（劳森）则上升至第9位，无论怎样（regardless）#F1 #USGP
detailEn: Think VCARB might not run Lawson in Q3 to ensure he doesn’t out qualify Lindblad. Lindblad then loses one fewer spot with his five-place grid penalty, and Lawson moves up to P9 regardless #F1 #USGP
